This shift of freight operations to DFC tracks improves the reliability of passenger train schedules, making travel more dependable for commuters. Businesses can expect significant [v] _____ in logistics costs due to faster trains and shorter transit times, making goods transportation more economical. Excerpted from: “The Future of Freight.” Outlook .
